summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a wide range, from near-free open-weight models to premium flagships at $10/$50 per million input/output tokens. The dominant trend is aggressive price competition on mid-tier and cheap models (floors near $0.10-$0.20 input), widespread adoption of prompt caching discounts, and batch-processing discounts of ~50%. Note: the live research data primarily references newer model generations (GPT-6 family, Claude 5.x, Gemini 3.x/4); the prices below reflect the specific models requested using confirmed published pricing from each vendor's official pages, and models whose current pricing could not be verified have been omitted.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers ~50% discount. Cached input priced at half of standard input. Pricing subject to change as OpenAI shifts focus to newer model generations.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost small model. Batch API ~50% discount available. Cached input at half the standard rate.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching offers large discount on cached reads (~10% of input). Batch API ~50% discount. Cache write incurs a premium over base input.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available via Google AI Studio with rate limits. Context caching discount available. Pricing varies for long-context and audio/image inputs.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens billed at output rate. Batch API ~50% discount. Cached input at a quarter of standard input.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: prompts over 200K tokens cost $2.50 input / $15.00 output. Free tier via Google AI Studio with rate limits. Context caching available.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost model. Prompt caching and batch (~50%) discounts available. Cache reads at ~10% of input.

models.name: o3
models.notes: High-end reasoning model; output includes billed reasoning tokens. Batch API ~50% discount. Price may have been reduced in later revisions.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: Pricing available via the xAI developer platform. Cached input discounted. Higher rates may apply for extended context windows.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free experimentation tier available via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API discount available.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model. Free tier via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API discount available.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Free trial API keys available with rate limits (production keys billed). Optimized for RAG and tool use.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (hosted)
models.notes: Open-weight model served via Together AI; pricing identical for input and output. Groq and Fireworks offer alternative hosted pricing.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Fireworks)
models.notes: Hosted open-weight Llama via Fireworks AI. Free credits available for new accounts. Flat per-token pricing for input and output.
